description: manage bare-metal machines through their BMCs (Redfish) and the pk-metal operator that runs in a Kubernetes cluster.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: show machines, BMCs, claims and operations, and why one is stuck

commands.name: check
commands.summary: test that a BMC answers; list its virtual media and systems

commands.name: inventory
commands.summary: read the hardware inventory of a BMC and print it as YAML

commands.name: render
commands.summary: write Talos machine configs, talosconfig and kubeconfig from files

commands.name: relay
commands.summary: forward boot media between the BMC network and pk-metal boot

commands.name: sim
commands.summary: run simulated BMCs: serve one, or a fleet with a VM behind each

commands.name: completion
commands.summary: print the shell completion script for bash, zsh or fish

commands.name: version
commands.summary: print the version of this program

commands.name: top
commands.summary: live view of every machine; approve, hold and retry from it

commands.name: approve
commands.summary: list waiting operations, or show the plan of one and approve it

commands.name: retry
commands.summary: delete a failed or aborted operation, so that it is proposed again

commands.name: abort
commands.summary: stop an operation and undo what it left behind (media, cordon)

commands.name: reboot
commands.summary: propose a clean reboot of a Talos node: drain, reboot, uncordon

commands.name: hold
commands.summary: stop new operations for a claim; nothing on the machine changes

commands.name: unhold
commands.summary: remove a hold, so that the operator proposes operations again

commands.name: backup
commands.summary: take, list, download or decrypt etcd snapshots

commands.name: restore
commands.summary: plan the restore of a cluster's etcd; upload a snapshot for it

commands.name: wipe
commands.summary: ask for a wipe of a released machine (the operator proposes it)

commands.name: reinstall
commands.summary: ask for a new install of a node on the same machine

commands.name: replace
commands.summary: move a node to another machine, for failed hardware

commands.name: scale
commands.summary: show the machines a cluster gains or gives back; --apply does it

commands.name: rollout
commands.summary: list, show, approve, resume, pause or abort cluster rollouts

commands.name: upgrade
commands.summary: set the Talos or Kubernetes version of a cluster; show the rollout

commands.name: pivot
commands.summary: move the operator and its objects to another cluster

commands.name: boot
commands.summary: mount a config ISO through a BMC and REBOOT the machine into it

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.summary: start a new Talos cluster on booted machines, without the operator

globalFlags.name: kubeconfig
globalFlags.usage: kubeconfig file (default: $KUBECONFIG, then ~/.kube/config, then the in-cluster account)

globalFlags.name: context
globalFlags.usage: kubeconfig context to use (default: the current context)

exitStatus.meaning: error; the message is on stderr, as "pk-metal: <message>"
pk-metal status only: something is blocked or failed and needs a person
